description: Jerry Zimmerer, Tom Baker, and Marc Meyer are running as a Democratic slate for the Texas 15th Court of Appeals — the statewide court Greg Abbott built and filled with judges no Texan ever voted for. This November, you finally get a say.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Jerry Zimmerer for Justice Campaign, Tom Baker for Justice Campaign, and Marc Meyer for Justice, Place 3 Campaign
title: The People's Court | Zimmerer, Baker & Meyer for the Texas 15th Court of Appeals
